technical.summary: Long-term trend structure is bullish with golden cross, but short-term overbought conditions (RSI 9, StochRSI, Williams %R) and MACD weakness create pullback risk; moderate confluence with elevated caution.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 86 days adds timing risk with no offsetting fundamental catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional buy signals from junior members lack conviction; market fear (41 score) presents contrarian opportunity but insufficient supporting evidence from news or senior political activity.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (397.6), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and macro_score of -4 create severely unfavourable conditions; earnings in 86 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross (EMA 50/200) and price above all major moving averages establish long-term bullish structure with supertrend confirmation, offering structural upside if overbought conditions resolve.
debate.key_bear_argument: Crisis-level VIX (397.6), unfavourable macro environment (macro_score -4), multiple overbought oscillators (RSI 9, StochRSI, Williams %R), MACD bearish divergence, and zero fundamental catalysts create asymmetric downside risk with earnings event 86 days away.
